name: SonarQube Quality Hub
description: A modern read-only SonarQube workspace with project switching, analysis history, issue filtering and global quality insights.
releaseNotes: Rules are now selected through a searchable, paginated multi-select popover with rule keys and per-rule counts, and issues support filtering by several rules at once. Also removed native form submissions that are blocked in DBX's allow-scripts sandbox, so Apply Filters and Save Connection work reliably.
